description_en: Checks the inventory of Cloud Phone resources. Before you create an instance, call this operation to check whether resources are available in the target region. Create the instance only after you confirm that resources are available
description_zh: 检查云手机资源库存状态。在实例创建前，可先通过该接口检测目标region库存是否足够，确认足够后再进行创建
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic check-resource-stock --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --acp-spec-id acp.basic.small --gpu-acceleration false --amount 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckResourceStock

parameters.help_en: The zone where the resource resides
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance type
parameters.name: acp_spec_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable GPU acceleration
parameters.name: gpu_acceleration

parameters.help_en: The number of Cloud Phone instances
parameters.name: amount
